f26f972e-fd2f-4017-b231-840da080167f.description:
Job Description:
• The Field Sales Executive is a full-time, on-site position responsible for
identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, conducting client
meetings, and presenting Client’s web development, mobile application, and
staffing solutions to prospective customers.
• The individual will manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and
qualification to negotiation and closure, while maintaining accurate records of
activities in the sales pipeline.

Key Responsibilities:
• Identify, generate, and qualify new business leads through field visits,
networking, referrals, and other sales channels.
• Visit prospective clients, understand their business requirements, and present
suitable technology and staffing solutions.
• Conduct product presentations and demonstrations to corporate clients, SMEs,
and other prospective customers.
• Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, follow-ups,
negotiations, proposal preparation, and deal closure.

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with business owners, decision-
makers, and key stakeholders.

• Maintain accurate sales pipeline records and provide regular reports on sales
activities and performance.
• Collaborate with internal technical and delivery teams to understand client
requirements and ensure appropriate solutions are proposed.
• Achieve sales targets and contribute to the company's overall business growth.
• Travel to nearby locations as required for client meetings and business
development activities.

Salary and Incentives:
1. Salary: Up to ₹16 LPA, based on experience, skills, and performance.
2. Performance-based incentives in addition to the salary, linked to business
development and sales achievements.
3. Opportunity to earn additional rewards by meeting or exceeding sales targets.
4. Career growth opportunities in technology sales and business development.

Qualifications:
1. Strong field sales and business development skills, including lead generation,
client prospecting, and opportunity management.
2. Proficiency in relationship management, negotiation, and closing deals with
corporate and SME clients.
3. Ability to clearly present and explain web development, mobile application, and
staffing solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
4. Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
5. Familiarity with CRM tools, productivity software, and sales reporting.
6. Ability to work independently in the field, manage time effectively, and meet
sales targets.
7. A bachelor's degree in business, marketing, engineering, or a related field, or
equivalent practical experience in sales.
8. Willingness to travel to nearby areas for client visits and business development
activities.
9. Freshers with strong communication skills, a proactive attitude, and an interest
in sales are welcome to apply.

1. Position Details
Designation: Field Sales Executive
Company: HireNest Workforce Pvt. Ltd.
Employment Location: Work From Office / Field Visits
Initial Engagement: 45 Days – Freelance Basis
Proposed Monthly Compensation During Initial Engagement: ₹20,000 (inclusive of travel expenses), subject to the agreed performance and payment conditions.
Full-Time Salary: Up to ₹16 LPA, depending on experience, skills and performance, as applicable upon full-time onboarding.
Business Focus: Website Development, Mobile Application Development and IT Staffing Solutions.
Target Customers: Schools, Educational Institutions, Corporate Offices, SMEs and other prospective business customers.
Please refer to the attached JD for detailed responsibilities, qualifications and expectations.
2. Initial Engagement – 45 Days (Freelance & Performance Evaluation)
The selected candidate will initially undergo a 45-day freelance engagement and performance evaluation period before being considered for full-time onboarding with HireNest Workforce Pvt. Ltd.
Compensation and Performance Conditions:
The proposed monthly compensation during the initial 45-day period will be ₹20,000, inclusive of travel expenses, subject to the agreed performance and payment conditions.
Candidates must actively identify prospective customers, generate qualified business leads, conduct client meetings, follow up on opportunities and achieve the minimum sales targets prescribed by the company.
The first performance checkpoint will be within 25 calendar days from the date of joining.
If the candidate generates zero sales during the first 25 calendar days, the company may discontinue the engagement following a performance review.
Zero Sales – Zero Performance-Based Compensation: Under the agreed independent freelance arrangement, where payment is expressly conditional on achieving the agreed sales deliverables, zero sales may result in zero performance-based compensation for the relevant period, subject to applicable law and the written agreement.
Candidates who successfully achieve the prescribed sales targets and complete the 45-day evaluation may be considered for full-time onboarding with HireNest Workforce Pvt. Ltd.
3. Full-Time Onboarding After Successful Evaluation
Upon successful completion of the initial 45-day evaluation and achievement of the prescribed performance targets:
The candidate may be formally onboarded as a full-time employee of HireNest Workforce Pvt. Ltd.
Salary will be finalized as per the agreed employment offer and company compensation structure.
Applicable PF and other statutory benefits and deductions will be governed by applicable employment laws.
Performance-based incentives will be applicable as per company policy.
The candidate will transition from the initial freelance engagement to the company's regular employment structure.
4. Vendor Commercial Terms – Recruitment Partnership
For this particular recruitment requirement, the recruitment partner/vendor will be eligible for a total recruitment service fee of:
4.165% of the candidate's agreed annual CTC.
4.1 Monthly Payment Structure
The total recruitment fee will be distributed equally across 12 months.
Monthly Vendor Fee = (Agreed Annual CTC × 4.165%) ÷ 12
4.2 Payment Eligibility
The total recruitment fee will be payable in monthly installments for a maximum period of 12 months.
Monthly payments will be applicable only while the candidate continues in active employment with HireNest Workforce Pvt. Ltd.
Payments will be calculated based on the candidate's agreed annual CTC and the applicable 12-month payment schedule.
Payments will be processed against the applicable vendor invoice and subject to the required documentation, verification and payment cycle.
4.3 Candidate Discontinuation Policy
If the candidate resigns, discontinues employment, is terminated or otherwise ceases to be employed before completing 12 months, the vendor will be eligible only for installments accrued up to the candidate's last eligible employment date.
No remaining or future installments will be payable after the candidate's discontinuation.
The vendor will not be entitled to claim the unpaid balance of the 12-month recruitment fee after the candidate's discontinuation.
Recruitment commission eligibility will commence upon the candidate's formal full-time onboarding and will not apply merely because the candidate joins the initial freelance engagement.
5. Candidate Submission Conditions
All recruitment partners must adhere to the following conditions:
Submit only genuine, relevant and pre-screened candidate profiles.
Obtain candidate consent before sharing resumes with HireNest.
Duplicate submissions and previously registered candidates will not qualify for recruitment fee eligibility.
Ensure that candidates are genuinely interested in field sales, business development, client acquisition and sales conversion.
Coordinate with the HireNest recruitment team for candidate screening, interviews, selection and joining formalities.
Do not make unauthorized salary, incentive or employment commitments to candidates.
6. Mandatory Candidate Transparency – Vendor Responsibility
This is a mandatory condition for all recruitment partners.
Before submitting any candidate profile, vendors must clearly explain the complete engagement and compensation structure to the candidate.
Candidates must be informed about:
The initial 45-day freelance engagement.
The proposed ₹20,000 monthly compensation, inclusive of travel expenses, subject to agreed performance and payment conditions.
The mandatory sales and business development targets.
The first performance checkpoint within 25 calendar days.
The possibility of discontinuation if zero sales are generated during the first 25 calendar days.
The zero-sales and zero-performance-based-compensation condition under the agreed freelance arrangement, subject to applicable law and written terms.
The possibility of full-time onboarding after successfully completing the 45-day evaluation and achieving the prescribed targets.
The applicable full-time salary structure and statutory benefits after formal onboarding.
Candidate Acknowledgement:
Vendors must obtain the candidate's confirmation that they have understood and agreed to the above engagement structure before forwarding their profile.
Please include the following declaration while submitting each candidate:
"We confirm that the candidate has been informed about the initial 45-day freelance engagement, proposed ₹20,000 monthly compensation inclusive of travel expenses, sales targets, zero-sales discontinuation condition, applicable performance-based payment conditions and subsequent full-time onboarding process. The candidate has acknowledged and agreed to proceed with the stated terms."
7. Important Instructions
Please work only on officially shared and active requirements.
Do not circulate this requirement with misleading compensation or employment information.
Submit only candidates who have understood and accepted the engagement structure.
Ensure that candidates are comfortable with field sales activities and business development responsibilities.
Vendor recruitment commission will be governed exclusively by the commercial terms mentioned in this email and the applicable recruitment partnership agreement.
8. Confirmation Required
Interested recruitment partners are requested to:
Acknowledge this email.
Confirm acceptance of the vendor commercial terms.
Confirm that candidates will be informed about the complete engagement and compensation structure before profile submission.
Start sourcing and share suitable candidate profiles along with their updated resumes and contact details, with candidate consent.
We look forward to receiving quality profiles and building a mutually beneficial recruitment partnership.
Thank you for your continued support and collaboration.

a3eeccbd-d420-4891-9bef-b3ff5a874f31.description:
Job Description:
The Field Sales Executive is a full-time, on-site position responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, conducting client meetings, and presenting Triyarc’s web development, mobile application, and staffing solutions to prospective customers.
The individual will manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and qualification to negotiation and closure, while maintaining accurate records of activities in the sales pipeline.

Key Responsibilities:
Identify, generate, and qualify new business leads through field visits, networking, referrals, and other sales channels.
Visit prospective clients, understand their business requirements, and present suitable technology and staffing solutions.
Conduct product presentations and demonstrations to corporate clients, SMEs, and other prospective customers.
Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, follow-ups, negotiations, proposal preparation, and deal closure.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with business owners, decision-makers, and key stakeholders.
Maintain accurate sales pipeline records and provide regular reports on sales activities and performance.
Collaborate with internal technical and delivery teams to understand client requirements and ensure appropriate solutions are proposed.
Achieve sales targets and contribute to the company's overall business growth.
Travel to nearby locations as required for client meetings and business development activities.
Probation period - 2months

Salary and Incentives:
Salary: Up to ₹16 LPA, based on experience, skills, and performance.
Performance-based incentives in addition to the salary, linked to business development and sales achievements.
Opportunity to earn additional rewards by meeting or exceeding sales targets.
Career growth opportunities in technology sales and business development.

Qualifications:
Strong field sales and business development skills, including lead generation, client prospecting, and opportunity management.
Proficiency in relationship management, negotiation, and closing deals with corporate and SME clients.
Ability to clearly present and explain web development, mobile application, and staffing solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
Familiarity with CRM tools, productivity software, and sales reporting.
Ability to work independently in the field, manage time effectively, and meet sales targets.
A bachelor's degree in business, marketing, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in sales.
Willingness to travel to nearby areas for client visits and business development activities.
Freshers with strong communication skills, a proactive attitude, and an interest in sales are welcome to apply.
Probation, Performance Evaluation & Termination Policy
1. Probation Period: The initial probation period will be 2 months from the date of joining.
2. Lead Generation Expectation: The employee is expected to generate at least one genuine and qualified business lead within the first 25 days from the date of joining.
3. Performance Evaluation: Performance will be evaluated based on genuine sales efforts, lead generation activities, client meetings, follow-ups, pipeline development and business development initiatives.
4. Training & Support: The company will provide the necessary product/service knowledge, training and guidance to help employees understand the company's offerings and sales expectations.
5. Market & Territory Considerations: Performance evaluation will reasonably consider market conditions, territory allocation, availability of prospective clients, lead accessibility and other factors beyond the employee's direct control.
6. Performance Review: If the expected lead generation target is not achieved within 25 days, the company will conduct a performance review to assess the employee's efforts, progress and challenges.
7. Probation Extension: Based on the performance review, the company may consider extending the probation period with clearly communicated expectations and measurable improvement objectives.
8. Termination Policy: Any decision regarding termination due to non-performance will follow a documented and consistently applied evaluation process, with appropriate prior communication and an opportunity for the employee to provide clarification.
9. Final Confirmation: Successful completion of probation will result in confirmation of employment and payment of the mutually agreed CTC.


. Salary Structure & Probation Period
Probation Duration: The initial probation period will be 2 months from the date of joining.
Probation Salary: During the 2-month probation period, the employee will receive a fixed salary of ₹18,000 per month.
Post-Probation Salary: Upon successful completion and clearance of the probation period, the employee's salary will be revised to the mutually agreed CTC as discussed and confirmed during the recruitment process.
Performance-based incentives will be applicable as per the company's incentive structure.

This is a full-time, on-site field sales position.
Employees are expected to independently identify prospective clients and develop new business opportunities.
Consistent performance, lead generation, client acquisition, and revenue contribution will be key evaluation parameters.
